about.label: { About Julia }
about.lead: Julia Usova works with private clients, political figures, television personalities, recording artists and modelling agencies.
about.more: Her experience spans Russia, Argentina, <br class="br-design">Paraguay and Brazil, covering television <br class="br-design">interviews, public appearances, professional <br class="br-design">shoots, weddings and private events.
expertise.title1: Her work is defined by controlled skin finishes, precise definition
expertise.title2: and careful attention <br class="br-compact">to lighting. <br class="br-design">Every look <br class="br-compact">is developed around <br class="br-compact">the client’s features, the setting and the demands of the camera.
expertise.p1: Julia approaches each appointment with careful preparation and an understanding of how makeup needs to perform throughout the day.
expertise.p2: Skin type, wear time, climate and comfort guide her choice of products and techniques, whether the assignment is a private celebration or a production. Her training includes study with leading Moscow makeup artists and continued professional development with Russian and European specialists.
expertise.p3: This foundation informs a considered approach that balances technical precision with the individual character of each client.
expertise.p4: Punctuality, discretion and efficient preparation are integral to her practice.

occasion.heading: Your Occasion. Your Look.
occasion.event.title: Event Makeup
occasion.event.desc: Personalised makeup designed around your skin, the lighting, your outfit and the impression you want to make.
occasion.event.inc1: A consultation to discuss your preferences and the desired look.
occasion.event.inc2: Skin preparation, complexion makeup, brows, eyes and lips.
occasion.event.inc3: Strip or individual cluster lashes where appropriate.
occasion.event.inc4: Makeup setting and a final check under makeup lighting.
occasion.event.foot: Hairstyling and touch-up support during the event are not included.
occasion.hair.title: Makeup & Hair
occasion.hair.desc: A complete, coordinated look, with makeup and hair created together by one artist.
occasion.hair.inc2: Styling or a hairstyle based on an agreed reference.
occasion.hair.inc3: Shape and volume tailored to your outfit, jewellery and hair.
occasion.hair.inc4: Placement of your own hair accessories and final setting.
occasion.hair.foot: Includes one agreed look. Touch-up support during the event can be arranged separately.
steps.heading: From Brief to First Shot
steps.s1.title: The Brief & Schedule
steps.s1.text: We agree on the format, references, number of people, wardrobe, location requirements and exact ready-by time. For television appearances, we also confirm whether the broadcaster provides a makeup artist.
steps.s2.title: Skin & Hair Preparation
steps.s2.text: We discuss individual needs and any known sensitivities, select suitable products and plan the order of preparation. Tools are prepared for each person.
steps.s3.title: Makeup for the Brief
steps.s3.text: For business appearances, the focus is on targeted correction, balanced shine control and a natural-looking complexion. Men’s preparation also includes brow and hair grooming. For creative projects, the references guide the level of definition and expression.
prep.c2.text: An even complexion, controlled shine and neatly styled hair, with preparation scheduled around your recording or broadcast time. For touch-ups during recording, book an on-set service.
prep.c2.title: TV Interviews & Live Broadcasts
prep.heading: Preparation That Fits Your Schedule
prep.c3.text: An agreed look, camera checks and touch-ups between takes, with attention to makeup and hair continuity throughout the shoot. Choose a 4-hour or 8-hour booking. Multiple models and complete changes of look are quoted separately.
prep.c3.title: Studio & Advertising Shoots
prep.audience: For production teams, press offices, talent managers and individual clients.
prep.c5.text: Preparation for shoots, premieres, interviews and stage appearances. References, ready-by times, coordination with management and permission for behind-the-scenes photography are agreed before the project.
prep.c5.title: Artists, Presenters & Celebrities
prep.c6.text: Discreet camera makeup and hair preparation for interviews, press conferences and public speaking. Targeted complexion correction and shine control help maintain a polished, familiar appearance. Scheduling and confidentiality can be coordinated with a press office, assistant or producer.
prep.c6.title: Executives, Politicians & Public Officials
agreed.heading: Everything Agreed in Advance
agreed.intro: Travel to your preparation location or set within Rio de Janeiro, transport and parking costs, delivery and setup of professional makeup equipment, makeup lighting, cosmetics and consumables, strip or individual cluster lashes where appropriate for the agreed makeup.
agreed.x1: Makeup for a second person at the same address
agreed.x2: Makeup & hair for a second person at the same address
agreed.note1: * Second-person rates apply to private events and weddings. Appointments take place consecutively during the same visit, and the additional person’s preparation time is included in their service price.
agreed.note2: * Staffing for productions is agreed separately. The early-start surcharge applies once per visit.
booking.r1.title: Minimum Booking
booking.r1.text: The minimum booking is R$ 1,500. Listed prices are final for the stated scope. The date, address, agreed look, ready-by time and any additional services are confirmed before the booking is finalised.
booking.r2.title: Reserved Time
booking.r2.text: Travel to the first address, equipment setup and packing do not reduce your paid service time. For shoots, preparation, waiting time and movement between locations are included in the reserved hours.
booking.r3.title: Bespoke Quotes
booking.r3.text: Travel outside Rio de Janeiro, intricate braiding, wigs, hairpieces or extensions, additional visits, complete changes of look and extra specialists are quoted individually. Any additional charges are agreed in advance.
booking.r4.title: Privacy
booking.r4.text: Names, photographs, videos and behind-the-scenes content are published only with prior consent. An NDA can be arranged for projects.
booking.r5.title: Separate Costs
booking.r5.text: Lash extensions, purchased accessories, venue hire and filming equipment are not included. The artist’s lighting is used for makeup preparation. Production lighting is supplied by the project team.
